messages:
maria: Quick Q — kicking off an access slimdown next week. Who owns the canonical list of 'org-admin' style grants across clouds? Need to lock scope for the rollout.
devin: I can take ownership of the list for this run. planning to snapshot roles by EOD today. :white_check_mark:
samir: +1. can we include KMS bindings and service account key owners in that snapshot? those are the usual surprises.
olivia: yes pls include KMS bindings. also add a column for 'last used' if we can pull it, helps with justifications.
maria: good call. for KMS specifically — are we delegating to project-level roles or using cross-project/service accounts?
ryan: currently mix. some teams use project KMS keys, others rely on a central keyring with IAM bindings. Problem is cross-project grants are hard to reason about.
devin: for the snapshot i'll include: role, principal, resource path, grant origin (console/terraform/iam-sync), and last_seen timestamp.
access-bot: Note: recent policy change requires keys with external bindings to have an approved justification tag. See /policies/key-binding-justification.
samir: question: what audit log query do folks use to surface ownerless admin activity? here's a quick CloudAudit example I run in BigQuery for GCP logs:
```
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal,
       resource.labels.project_id AS project,
       protoPayload.methodName AS method,
       timestamp
FROM `redwood-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%setIamPolicy%'
  AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(protoPayload.request, '$.policy.bindings') IS NOT NULL
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 250;
```
olivia: nice. can we add a filter to only show principals that are in the 'admin' groups table (so we can focus on risky grants)?
maria: yes — i want a pre-filtered export we can hand to app teams for justification collection.
devin: also: what retention window for audit evidence do we need to keep to satisfy compliance? 1yr? 2yr?
ryan: for customers in EU regulated verticals we keep 2 yrs, default org policy is 13 months. we'll need to surface exceptions.
samir: remediation plan idea: automated email to owner with 7d TTL, then auto-remove non-justified grants via a canary job (manual approval before destructive changes). Thoughts?
olivia: include a canary target set (non-prod projects) first. also add a manual pause hook in the runbook.
maria: agreed. also need a safe rollback path — if we remove a binding and something breaks, how do teams re-enable quickly?
devin: keep a reversible change via iactool: create a revert PR that records the removed bindings as a patch and a runbook snippet to apply revert. Tag with incident-channel on failure.
ryan: add a monitoring hook: if server 5xx rate or latency for a flagged service increases by X% within 30m of change, auto-open an incident and pause further removals.
access-bot: Automation suggestion: create an 'access-slimdown' checklist artifact in /playbooks/ with steps: snapshot -> notify -> collect justification -> canary revoke -> monitor -> revoke global.
maria: one more KMS question — when we talk about 'bindings' do we also scrub key ACLs and CryptoKey IAM policies (not just top-level keyring)? some teams attach grants at cryptoKey level.
samir: yes, include cryptoKey level. i recommend we capture resource_type (keyring/cryptoKey) in the snapshot.
devin: i'll put together a short PR with the query set (GCP + AWS CloudTrail snippet) and the CSV schema for export. can someone review today?
olivia: reviewing in a bit. please drop link when ready. :mag_right:
devin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security-playbooks/pull/482 (draft)
ryan: scanning — looks good. add a note in the PR about cross-project service accounts used by pipelines (we need owner outreach).
maria: thanks team. plan: snapshot today, draft outreach monday, first canary revoke weds. i'll post the final checklist and escalation contacts in #eng-oncall and #prod.
olivia: fyi — raising this in monthly compliance review so legal sees the justification template.
samir: anyone want me to run a quick ownerless-admin detection job tonight? I can run and attach CSV to the PR.
devin: please do. saves us time.
maria: perfect. thanks. :pray:
access-bot: Automation note: scheduled job 'ownerless-admin-scan' will run at 02:00 UTC and post results to the thread when complete.
